speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim
text: asked the Minister for Communications and Information whether there is any regulation or safeguard to ensure that service staff of telecommunications companies in Singapore are aware of any red flags, to prevent vulnerable groups, such as elderly or special needs adults, from being exploited or scammed to sign up for mobile lines and phone contracts.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister fo r Communications and Information)
text: These measures are intended to protect all consumers, including those in the vulnerable groups.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister fo r Communications and Information)
text: The Government also works with the people, private and public sectors, on ground-up initiatives under the Digital for Life movement, to uplift digital literacy among vulnerable groups.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister fo r Communications and Information)
text: Taken together, these consumer protection measures and public education programmes help to protect our population from exploitation and scams by bad actors.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister fo r Communications and Information)
text: The public can also remain vigilant by learning to identify and avoid scams and scam tactics, such as signing up for mobile lines on behalf of strangers.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister fo r Communications and Information)
text: All of us have a part to play in helping the more vulnerable segments of our community.

speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim (Chua Chu Kang)
text: Their 31-year-old intellectually disabled son was tricked to sign up for different telco lines and mobile phone contracts.

speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim (Chua Chu Kang)
text: My question is given the vulnerability of individuals, like elderly or intellectually disabled adults, can MCI work with telcos to train or raise awareness amongst the frontline staff to have a checklist of red flags when it comes to contracting, perhaps similar to tellers at frontline banks, so that we can prevent our vulnerable individuals and adults and elderly residents from falling prey to such scams.

speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
text: It is always particularly heart-wrenching and upsetting when you hear about crimes and scams targeting the more vulnerable in our population – the elderly or people with disabilities.

speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
text: For that particular case, I am glad that the case was quickly dealt with by the IMDA colleagues and the telcos, and I thank the Member, Mr Zhulkarnain, for commending the IMDA team on that.

speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
text: It is something that we will continue to review.
